ours: monthly stock returns (formation-period and holding-period returns)

signal_formula_words.ours: Information discreteness (ID): the sign of the formation-period cumulative return (PRET) times the percentage of formation-period days with negative daily returns minus the percentage with positive daily returns. Daily return signs are equally weighted, ignoring magnitude. Small (low) ID = continuous information; large (high) ID = discrete information. Stocks are first sorted on PRET, then on ID.
signal_formula_words.reference: PRET = cumulative return over the past 12 months skipping the most recent month; ID = sgn(PRET) * (%neg - %pos), where %pos and %neg are the fractions of formation-period days with positive and negative returns (eq. 1). Low ID = continuous information.

formation_window.ours: 12 months: PRET is the cumulative return over the past twelve months after skipping the most recent month; ID uses the daily returns of the same formation period

skip_window.ours: 1 month (one intermediate month between formation and holding periods)

rebalance_frequency.ours: monthly (portfolios formed each month; handling of overlapping six-month holding periods not stated)

breakpoints.ours: Sequential 5x5 double sort: PRET quintiles first, then ID quintiles within each PRET quintile; breakpoint universe (NYSE vs all stocks) not stated
breakpoints.reference: double sort: momentum winners/losers (quintiles or deciles on PRET), then quintiles on ID within momentum groups

favored_group.ours: past winners (highest PRET quintile) in the lowest-ID (continuous information) subportfolio

disfavored_group.ours: past losers (lowest PRET quintile) in the lowest-ID (continuous information) subportfolio

headline_result.ours: Six-month momentum (winners minus losers) is 5.94% (t = 4.63) in the continuous-information (low ID) quintile versus –2.07% in the discrete (high ID) quintile; the 8.01% difference has a t-statistic of 8.54 (post-1927).
headline_result.reference: six-month momentum return (winners minus losers) by ID quintile: 5.94 % per six months, lowest-ID (continuous) quintile (CRSP 1927-2007)
